about: two companions answer together about the Haakman
reply: {"lines":[{"speaker":"npc_wouter","text":"The Haakman is a Blackmere thing; grey as a heron, teeth like water-weed, long hook—best to leave the water be, old nails help."},{"speaker":"npc_gerrit","text":"Haakman drags down those who mock the water; I'd sooner nail my doorstep myself than meet his hook."}]}
